text:
maya: heads up — node gpu-prod-07 (us-west2, rack-3) is spiking ECC corrected counts and showing repeated Xid 43s after we brought it back from the vendor. filing a quick soak run before we re-enable it in the pool. ticket INC-4321 for context. dmesg extract below:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 43, PID: 2143, GPU:00000000:AF:00
[ 12346.123456] NVRM: GPU ecc corrected errors increased by 312
[ 12352.987654] nvidia 0000:af:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus
```
maya: basic plan — cordon & drain node, run stress-cycle (mem + compute + power/thermal cycling) for 6h, collect ECC/Xid counters + temps every minute, fail on any new Xid 43 or ECC corrected delta > 500. if it passes, return to autoscaling group; if not, mark for replacement. thoughts? :eyes:
omar: +1 on the stress combination. can you confirm GPU model and firmware? last time fw mismatch caused weird resets.
maya: A100-SXM4 80GB, fw 52.10.01 (same as vendor returned). we've got nvml logs attached to the ticket.
ben: suggest we add variance in workload — short high-power spikes + idle periods to catch flaky thermal behavior. also include a kernel power cycle (reboot after heavy run) to trigger any racey re-init. i normally use this sequence:
```
# on node
kubectl cordon gpu-prod-07
kubectl drain gpu-prod-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
ssh ops@gpu-prod-07
# start logging
mkdir -p /var/log/gpu-soak/1767890123 && cd /var/log/gpu-soak/1767890123
# sample logging loop
while true; do nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,name,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,memory.used,pcie.link.gen.current --format=csv >> gpu_stats.csv; nvidia-smi --query-accounted-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv >> app_mem.csv; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.uncorrected.volatile,ecc.errors.corrected.volatile --format=csv >> ecc.csv; sleep 60; done &
# run stress containers with different loads
docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.7-base nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv
# run cuda stress test (gpu-burn or custom)
./run_gpu_burn.sh --duration 360
```
ben: also capture kernel logs with continuous journalctl tail and set kdump on so we have memory if it OOPSes.
lina: what about thermal cycling? do we need to physically ramp fans or move node to cold rack? past flaky cards were heat-sensitive.
ben: thermal cycling via fan policy is ok for initial repro — set fans to 100% for the high-power phases, then normal for idle. ops team can schedule physical cold-rack if that doesn't reproduce.
soak-bot: soak job created: soak-1767890123 for gpu-prod-07, window: 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-19T08:00:00Z. Logs will stream to s3://redwood-gpu-soak/gpu-prod-07/1767890123/. Thresholds: fail_on_xid=true, xid_threshold=1, ecc_delta_threshold=500.
maya: plan to start in ~30m after maintenance window opens. who can own the run & watch? @omar?
omar: I can watch the first 2h, will alert on first Xid and take node offline. can someone add a quick dashboard for ECC delta and Xid count so we don't have to stare at logs?
sre-oncall: I'll pin a temp panel in grafana under cluster/soak/gpu-prod-07 and add an alert: if Xid rate > 0 OR ecc_corrected_delta > 0 within 6h, PagerDuty to incident-sre. setting alert now.
lina: fallback criteria for vendor RMA? i'd say: any uncorrected ECC error OR Xid 43 > 3 within 6h OR repeated GPU falling off bus events -> open RMA with vendor and tag node as 'replace'.
maya: agreed. also added a post-run checklist in the ticket: logs archived, node cordoned status, soak summary with cnt_xid, ecc_delta, max_temp, uptime. if pass -> uncordon during low traffic window and run a 2h smoke with real production jobs pinned.
ben: one more: capture nvlink error counters too (if present) — sometimes link flaps look like GPU faults.
soak-bot: soak job started. running phase: high-power spikes (5m on / 3m idle) x 72 cycles. current status: cycle 1/72, no new Xid yet, ecc_corrected_delta=0. logs: s3://redwood-gpu-soak/gpu-prod-07/1767890123/stream.log
maya: thanks. i'll update INC-4321 with the soak config and invite vendor if we hit failing thresholds. will call for replacement if we see reproducible failures in 2 consecutive soak runs.
omar: noted. will keep channel updated. :thumbsup:
